name: ux-ui-skills
description: Two standalone UX/UI skills: one for design and implementation, one for expert heuristic review.

interface.shortDescription: Build and review user interfaces with UX/UI judgment.
interface.longDescription: A skills-only package containing ux-ui-build for authorized interface design and implementation work, and ux-ui-review for read-only expert UX/UI critique. The skills apply usability, accessibility-signal, ethical-UX, pattern, and boundary guidance without claiming formal user testing, legal review, security review, or WCAG certification.
defaultPrompt: Audit this flow for UX risks.
